title: Viajero de Novela Ligera en Acuarela: Ilustración de Aventura Japonesa-Escandinava con Mapa de Viaje
prompt: A charming watercolor illustration in Japanese light novel style with Scandinavian color influences. A young woman with short pink hair, wearing a beige Norwegian wool trench coat and a hand-knitted blue Icelandic scarf, stands holding an aged travel map of Nordic countries and Japan. She is pulling two vintage brown leather suitcases from a Copenhagen leather workshop on wheels. The background features a large, detailed fantasy world map covered with handwritten notes in Japanese and Norwegian, travel sketches of Mount Fuji and Bergen's waterfront, and pinned photographs from her journeys across Japan, Sweden, Denmark, and Iceland, creating a visual travel scrapbook aesthetic. The colors are warm, soft, and earthy with a textured watercolor paper feel reminiscent of both Japanese and Scandinavian illustration traditions. The mood is adventurous, nostalgic, and wanderlust-filled. Full body shot with gentle lighting.
